description: This file defines API endpoints for managing organizations within a system, including creating, updating, deleting, listing, and managing members and activity related to organizations. It uses FastAPI and interacts with a database via Prisma, handling organization data, permissions, budgets, and member roles.

classes.name: LiteLLM_OrganizationTable
classes.description: Represents an organization record in the database.

classes.name: LiteLLM_OrganizationTableWithMembers
classes.description: Extends organization data with related members, teams, and object permissions.

classes.name: LiteLLM_OrganizationMembershipTable
classes.description: Represents a member's role and budget within an organization.

classes.name: LiteLLM_UserTable
classes.description: Represents a user record in the database.

classes.name: LiteLLM_BudgetTable
classes.description: Represents a budget record associated with an organization or member.

classes.name: NewOrganizationRequest
classes.description: Data model for creating a new organization.

classes.name: OrganizationMemberAddRequest
classes.description: Data model for adding members to an organization.

classes.name: OrganizationMemberUpdateRequest
classes.description: Data model for updating a member in an organization.

classes.name: OrganizationMemberDeleteRequest
classes.description: Data model for removing a member from an organization.

classes.name: OrganizationAddMemberResponse
classes.description: Response model for adding members to an organization.

classes.name: SpendAnalyticsPaginatedResponse
classes.description: Response model for paginated daily activity data.

classes.name: BudgetNewRequest
classes.description: Data model for creating or updating a budget.

methods.name: handle_nested_budget_structure_in_organization_update_request
methods.description: Transforms nested UI budget data into flat structure for processing.

methods.name: new_organization
methods.description: Creates a new organization, setting budgets, permissions, and models, only accessible by admins.

methods.name: get_organization_daily_activity
methods.description: Retrieves daily activity data for specified organizations.

methods.name: update_organization
methods.description: Updates organization details, including metadata, budgets, and permissions.

methods.name: handle_update_object_permission
methods.description: Handles creation or update of object permissions for an organization.

methods.name: delete_organization
methods.description: Deletes specified organizations along with related teams, members, and tokens.

methods.name: list_organization
methods.description: Lists organizations accessible to the user, either all (admin) or those they belong to.

methods.name: info_organization
methods.description: Fetches detailed info about a specific organization.

methods.name: deprecated_info_organization
methods.description: Deprecated endpoint for organization info, use GET /organization/info instead.

methods.name: organization_member_add
methods.description: Adds new members to an organization, creating users if necessary.

methods.name: find_member_if_email
methods.description: Finds a user by email in the user table.

methods.name: organization_member_update
methods.description: Updates a member’s role or budget within an organization.

methods.name: organization_member_delete
methods.description: Removes a member from an organization.

methods.name: add_member_to_organization
methods.description: Adds a user to an organization, creating user record if needed.
